cuts.label: joebartolozzi@momenttireddependablegoblinmrdestructoid-3x7wqdn4vov78eq9/joebartolozzi-about-bart-2026w41
cuts.title: Joe said GTA can't get him in trouble, then this mission started
cuts.hook: Joe said GTA is fine for Twitch
cuts.retelling: Joe Bartolozzi insists nothing in GTA can get him in trouble on Twitch, then the next mission turns out to be photographing a celebrity having sex, and he ends up telling his editor to blur the whole thing.

cuts.label: scout:harmless+jerma985+pokelawls/harmless-jerma985-pokelawls-bike-charact-2026w41
cuts.title: Jerma tries to fuel a bike in GTA RP and it explodes
cuts.hook: Jerma pumps fuel into a bike
cuts.retelling: Jerma clumsily pumps fuel into a bike in GTA RP while calling for a helper named Donnie, the bike explodes and he laughs and denies it's his, but Pokelawls's stream shows it was Pokelawls's bike and he panics.

cuts.label: xqc@vod2872612045/xqc-about-charact-2026w37
cuts.title: xQc's RP crew raps for a record deal and gets a $100K offer
cuts.hook: Brickbois rap for a record deal
cuts.retelling: xQc's GTA RP crew freestyles a burger-themed rap for a label exec, who tells them they passed and promises a $100,000 advance and radio play.

cuts.label: scout:stableronaldo/stableronaldo-ball-face-2026w39
cuts.title: Stableronaldo is stuck in a plywood room and they throw a ball at him through a hole
cuts.hook: Can he get out before the ball?
cuts.retelling: A streamer and his friend lose a helmet over a plywood wall and get trapped inside, and when he begs to be let out, the people outside throw a ball at his face through a hole.

cuts.label: silky@vod2876344120/silky-about-culture-2026w38
cuts.title: Silky didn't know durags were Black culture
cuts.hook: Silky didn't know durags were Black culture
cuts.retelling: Silky says he was shocked to learn durags count as Black American culture, and when chat asks how he can say that, he explains his Caribbean family never raised him around cookout culture.

cuts.label: jynxzi@momentgrosssmellybubbleteamvgame-a-ahkjjslbajojhs/jynxzi-cave-creep-2026w41
cuts.title: They warned Los about the creeper all stream
cuts.retelling: Jynxzi's team keeps warning Los about a creeper under him and Jynxzi leads him through, but a creeper drops on him anyway and he admits it was his fault.

cuts.label: scout:kaicenat/kaicenat-cenat-detent-2026w30
cuts.title: Kai Cenat gives the first detention in stream history
cuts.retelling: Kai tells a begging guest he's the first person ever to get detention and puts the detention sign on the guest's stream, then on a later stream Kai starts calling students to the main office.

cuts.label: squeex@momentsneakyminiaturesowbabyrage-5c9hnmwgidmbkmef/squeex-about-charact-2026w38
cuts.title: Chatterbox pins the shooting on the mayor, then gets taken down
cuts.hook: Chatterbox blames the mayor, then gets taken
cuts.retelling: Chatterbox says he panicked and shot someone named Carmella, he and squeex's mayor blame each other, the mayor says he'd see him behind bars, and then Chatterbox gets tased or taken down and sent off.

cuts.label: yugi@vod2873430416/yugi-night-over-2026w38
cuts.title: Yugi made strangers swap phones and his group lost a bet
cuts.retelling: Yugi gets two strangers to swap phones, the group looks in one phone's chat with someone called Joanna, and then says they lost a bet over it, but a stranger can't tell what was in the chat or what the bet was.
